Implements **P0.07** (`docs/tickets/07_P0.07__egress-proxy.md`) — spec §12.7, §12.8(d), §12.6 URL policy, §12.4 steps 4/9. Stacked on `stevevitali/cloud-switch-gcp`.

## Summary
`apps/egress-proxy` is the only route out of the sandbox subnet: a TypeScript forward proxy (undici, not Envoy — per-run policy needs a DB lookup + body rewriting) that is, for every run, the **usage meter of record**, the run cap's **enforcer**, the **fetch log of record**, and the **credential gate** that presents the direct Anthropic API key only for a valid per-run credential bound to the run's orchestrator-issued allowlist. This closes the v1.0 unmetered-inference-channel defect (a `node -e` shell escape has no credential → 403).

The pipeline (`handleProxyRequest`) is **pure of the network** — the forward step is injected — so every acceptance criterion is proven deterministically in-process against fixture Anthropic responses. Live wiring (network bind, Secret Manager key source, DB-backed resolver, real container image) is gated on a GCP deploy and recorded in DEFERRALS.

## What changed
- **`apps/egress-proxy/src`** — new modules: `rates` (versioned rate tables + list-cost math), `usage-block` (JSON+SSE usage/model extraction), `metering` (rows of record), `cap` (accountant), `credential` (gate + header scrub), `url-policy` (server-tool body injection), `outbound-limits` + `ngram` + `domains` (§12.8d), `fetch-log`, `sinks` (SQL writers, Secret Manager provider, in-memory fakes), `signals` (egress.denied event + pause signal + denial-spike), `ids` (ULID), `handler` (the pipeline), `server` (undici forwarder + node:http shell).
- **`packages/db`** — additive migration `0006_fetch_log_attempt.sql` + Drizzle column, so the fetch log carries the run/attempt/agent tagging AC6 requires (extend-by-migration, never rename).
- **DEFERRALS.md** — P0.07 section (live service, Secret Manager key, DB-backed resolver / richer allowlist persistence in P0.08, real image, SSE response-side fetch logging).

## Design decisions
- The credential + URL-policy checks are a **deliberate second, independent implementation** (defense in depth; not shared with `@rhema/hooks` or `run-task`, per ticket Notes).
- Credential **minting + allowlist authoring are P0.08** — validated/consumed here via the `RunContextResolver` DI seam.
- The fetch log's per-fetch/search rows are sourced from the **response** (this turn's real activity, logged once), not the request body (which carries full history — would re-log every turn).
- Metering derives cost only from the provider **response** usage + the run's rate table; an un-nameable/un-priceable model **throws** rather than metering silently (never an unmetered channel).

## Verification
- `npx vitest run apps/egress-proxy` → **63 pass / 12 files**, incl. a PGlite integration test writing `usage_records` + `fetch_log` against the real migrated schema.
- `pnpm test` → **488 pass** (baseline 425). `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` → **78 tasks green**.
